title: tests.py given every test file by a shell glob runs the whole suite without the host lock
goal: tests.py's named-files exemption (wants_host_lock and named_files_only) holds only for a run cheap enough to skip the lock (e.g. one file, or a few files on one worker), so python3 _tools/tests.py _tools/test_*.py takes /tmp/kb-tests.lock like a full run; a test plants a many-file argument list and sees the lock taken; found by the SP-3siaqxdf review of BG-tm3g5pha

run: import sys,glob;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import tests;assert tests.wants_host_lock(sorted(glob.glob('_tools/test_*.py'))), 'a run naming every test file takes no host lock'
